spec:
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  a
 - input  b
 - input  c
 - input  d
 - output out

The module should implement the circuit described by the Karnaugh map
below.

              ab
   cd   00  01  11  10
   00 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 1 |
   01 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
   11 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
   10 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 |
final_design:
module TopModule (
    input  logic a,
    input  logic b,
    input  logic c,
    input  logic d,
    output logic out
);

  assign out = (~c & ~d & ~a & ~b) |
               (~c & ~d & ~a &  b) |
               (~c & ~d &  a & ~b) |
               (~c &  d & ~a & ~b) |
               (~c &  d &  a & ~b) |
               ( c &  d & ~a &  b) |
               ( c &  d &  a &  b) |
               ( c &  d &  a & ~b) |
               ( c & ~d & ~a & ~b) |
               ( c & ~d & ~a &  b);

endmodule
